question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) as month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as year_2016,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as year_2017,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as year_2018
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY month

WITH monthly_delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) as month,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) as year,
        COUNT(*) as count
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
        AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)),
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
)
SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2016 THEN count ELSE 0 END) as year_2016,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN count ELSE 0 END) as year_2017,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN count ELSE 0 END) as year_2018
FROM monthly_delivered
WHERE month BETWEEN 1 AND 12
GROUP BY month
